Riley Chen: quick PR to tighten the Error Reference for 429s/timeouts. Found a few places that imply parsing partial stream chunks 1 not ideal. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9802
Maya Singh: good catch. I'll add a short note to prefer numeric status checks + Retry-After handling and remove the risky example.
Omar Diaz: can we add a tiny SDK v2 snippet showing trim-to-tail + retry_policy? Keep it copy-paste ready.
Maya Singh: adding this minimal snippet (pseudo):
Maya Singh: """python
resp = client.responses.stream(model='rwd-light-1', input=trim_tail(prompt, 2048))
try:
  for chunk in resp:
    handle(chunk)
except StreamError as e:
  if getattr(e, 'status_code', None) == 429:
    wait_and_retry(trim_tail(prompt, 1024))
"""
Riley Chen: also add a one-line decision note: Resume only if idempotent and resume token present; otherwise fallback (trim/switch model).
docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9802  CI queued
